3. Determine if you need a scrypt3 or scrypt4 file. The scrypt{3/4} value is based on the machine type. To display the hardware generation (machine type), select Administration > Device > System Settings. In the Product ID value, the machine type is the first 4 numbers, For example, 843652X, is machine type or M/T 8436. Match the machine type or M/T:  1. If the display shows "2426", "7199" or "7198", use scrypt of the form zzNNNN.licenses.scrypt3. M/T 7199 and M/T 7198 use scrypt3 files and run V4 or newer firmware. 
        2. If the display shows "5725", use scrypt of the form zzNNNN.licenses.scrypt4. M/T 5725 is for Virtual Appliances. 
        3. If the display shows "8436" use idgNNN.license.script3

When the reinitialize command completes, your network IP configurations, user accounts and other configuration options, are no longer accessible. 

You will only be able to connect to the appliance using the serial connection. 

You will need to configure your Ethernet and all other settings again using the information in the product information center available from our library page [http://www.ibm.com/software/integration/datapower/library/index.html].

Important points: 

 * Make sure you have a working serial connection to the appliance. 
   
   
 * The admin password will revert to the initial value of "admin" after the command executes.
   
   
 * A firmware image must be on the appliance prior to running the command. The firmware image used for the last upgrade of the device is removed from the file system automatically when the device reboots. Use DataPower's File Management WebGUI option to confirm you have an image or use these CLI commands:
   xi52# configure
   xi52# dir image:
   If an image file is not found, you will need to load a firmware image to the appliance into the image:/// directory. For example: you can use the WebGUI file management options or from the Control Panel, choose the System Control icon, the under Boot Image, choose the firmware file upload options.
   
   
 * Use the DataPower File Management to confirm you have sufficient file space. If you don't have sufficient file space, you can delete domains or other files to free up file space to allow the firmware image to be loaded to the appliance. 
   
   
 * reinit is a CLI command available in the config-flash# mode, for example:
   
   xi52# configure terminal
   Global configuration mode 
   xi52(config)# flash 
   Flash configuration mode 
   xi52(config-flash)#

If your appliance was shipped with 6.0.1.0 or later pre-installed, you can use the normal process for your appliance machine type to add the Extended Oracle support for Database Connectivity. RELATED INFORMATION
#Upgrading a DataPower appliance to add a field upgrade [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21507058]


 


Cross reference information Segment Product Component Platform Version Edition Business Integration WebSphere DataPower Service Gateway XG45 Firmware 6.0.1.0 All Editions Business Integration WebSphere DataPower Integration Blade XI50B 6.0.1.0

Normally, you can upgrade a license feature without needing to contact IBM Support.  * For appliances purchased through Passport Advantage, you would obtain the upgrade through Passport Advantage [http://www.ibm.com/software/lotus/passportadvantage/] 
 * For pre-Passport Advantage appliances, you would use the following technote: Upgrading a DataPower appliance to add a field upgrade feature [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21507058].


However, if your appliance was not shipped with firmware version 6.0.1.0 or later pre-installed, you must contact IBM Support [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21236322] to enable Extended Oracle support for Database Connectivity.

Part 3: Preparing for the firmware upgrade. 
Review the installation instructions and prepare your appliance for the firmware upgrade. 
 1. Read the upgrade documentation in the version-specific DataPower information center. Instructions for accessing the correct information center is in the [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=2362&uid=swg21377654]IBM WebSphere DataPower Product Documentation Portal [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=2362&uid=swg21377654] technical flash. The steps in this flash provide additional information to use with the upgrade documentation in the information center. 
 2. Save the current configuration.  * From the WebGUI, click Save Config. 
     * From the command line, issue the write memory command. 
    
    
 3. Create a backup of the entire system, and store the configuration in a safe location off of the appliance. 
 4. Confirm that you have a working admin account and a back up privileged account that can change the password for the admin account, if needed. 
 5. Make sure that the passwords for both accounts were recently changed.

You are now ready to continue to Part 2 to download the firmware image. 

Part 2: Downloading the firmware image. 
 1. Download the image. 
 2. Do not transfer the image to the appliance at this time. You will install the image in Part 4: Installing the firmware image.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  The pre-defined patterns are not updated when the firmware
   image is upgraded from 6.0.0.0, 6.0.0.1, or 6.0.0.2.

*  Fix is available in 6.0.0.3.
   
   For a list of the latest fix packs available, please see:
   http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21237631 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21237631]
   
   
    
   
   

TEMPORARY FIX

COMMENTS

If your appliance was shipped with 6.0.1.0 or later pre-installed, you can use the normal process for your appliance machine type to add the Extended Oracle support for Database Connectivity. RELATED INFORMATION
#Upgrading a DataPower appliance to add a field upgrade [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21507058]


 


Cross reference information Segment Product Component Platform Version Edition Business Integration WebSphere DataPower Service Gateway XG45 Firmware 6.0.1.0 All Editions Business Integration WebSphere DataPower Integration Blade XI50B 6.0.1.0

Normally, you can upgrade a license feature without needing to contact IBM Support.  * For appliances purchased through Passport Advantage, you would obtain the upgrade through Passport Advantage [http://www.ibm.com/software/lotus/passportadvantage/] 
 * For pre-Passport Advantage appliances, you would use the following technote: Upgrading a DataPower appliance to add a field upgrade feature [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21507058].


However, if your appliance was not shipped with firmware version 6.0.1.0 or later pre-installed, you must contact IBM Support [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21236322] to enable Extended Oracle support for Database Connectivity.

Part 3: Preparing for the firmware upgrade. 
Review the installation instructions and prepare your appliance for the firmware upgrade. 
 1. Read the upgrade documentation in the version-specific DataPower information center. Instructions for accessing the correct information center is in the [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=2362&uid=swg21377654]IBM WebSphere DataPower Product Documentation Portal [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=2362&uid=swg21377654] technical flash. The steps in this flash provide additional information to use with the upgrade documentation in the information center. 
 2. Save the current configuration.  * From the WebGUI, click Save Config. 
     * From the command line, issue the write memory command. 
    
    
 3. Create a backup of the entire system, and store the configuration in a safe location off of the appliance. 
 4. Confirm that you have a working admin account and a back up privileged account that can change the password for the admin account, if needed. 
 5. Make sure that the passwords for both accounts were recently changed.

You are now ready to continue to Part 2 to download the firmware image. 

Part 2: Downloading the firmware image. 
 1. Download the image. 
 2. Do not transfer the image to the appliance at this time. You will install the image in Part 4: Installing the firmware image.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  The pre-defined patterns are not updated when the firmware
   image is upgraded from 6.0.0.0, 6.0.0.1, or 6.0.0.2.

*  Fix is available in 6.0.0.3.
   
   For a list of the latest fix packs available, please see:
   http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21237631 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21237631]
   
   
    
   
   

TEMPORARY FIX

COMMENTS

IBM How to use the LIKE operator, wildcard and special characters in your IBM FileNet Content Platform Engine Sweep's Filter Expression - United States

TECHNOTE (FAQ)

QUESTION
 How to use the LIKE operator, wildcard and special characters in your IBM FileNet Content Platform Engine Sweep's Filter Expression? 

CAUSE
A sweep is an instance of a background service that you configure to process objects in a database table or some other set of items. To optimize sweep performance, you can optionally make the filter expression for the sweep a part of the WHERE clause of the sweep query. This inclusion means that the sweep retrieves only those database rows that satisfy the filter conditions.
The criteria is expressed in terms of properties and values of the objects that are targeted by the sweep. The syntax is a subset of the SQL syntax for the WHERE clause. [S1]

QUESTION
 How to use the LIKE operator, wildcard and special characters in your IBM FileNet Content Platform Engine Sweep's Filter Expression? 

CAUSE
A sweep is an instance of a background service that you configure to process objects in a database table or some other set of items. To optimize sweep performance, you can optionally make the filter expression for the sweep a part of the WHERE clause of the sweep query. This inclusion means that the sweep retrieves only those database rows that satisfy the filter conditions.
The criteria is expressed in terms of properties and values of the objects that are targeted by the sweep. The syntax is a subset of the SQL syntax for the WHERE clause. [S1]

*  Before deploying different snapshots, restart the deployment
   manager when switching deployment between process servers or the
    Process Center server.
   
   
    
   
   

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  Deployment can fail when a process server is on the same cell as
    an IBM Process Center or other process servers and an advanced
   process application is deployed to the Process Center server or
   installed on the process server. This failure occurs because the
    server information is cached by the deployment manager during
   the first advanced deployment.

*  A fix will be included in IBM BPM V8.5.7 cumulative fix 2016.12
   that prevents the server information from being cached during
   deployment when there are multiple deployment environments
   detected on the same cell.
   
   To determine whether the cumulative fix is available and
   download it if it is, complete the following steps on Fix
   Central:
   
   1. On the Select product tab, select WebSphere as the product
   group, IBM Business Process Manager with your edition from the
   WebSphere options, All as the installed version, and All as the
   platform, and then click Continue.
   2. In the Text field, enter "cumulative fix", and click
   Continue.

*  -----
   For a "Advanced-only Process Server" BPM Development
   environment the user need not run the
   bootstrapProcessServerData script. The user can skip the
   bootstrapProcessServerData script and execute the rest of steps
   suggested in the Admin console > Servers > Deployment
   Environments > [DE_Name ]> Deferred Configuration  panel.

*  A fix for IBM BPM V8.5 is available so that no message is
   shown in Advanced-only cases.

   manager when switching deployment between process servers or the
    Process Center server.
   
   
    
   
   

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  Deployment can fail when a process server is on the same cell as
    an IBM Process Center or other process servers and an advanced
   process application is deployed to the Process Center server or
   installed on the process server. This failure occurs because the
    server information is cached by the deployment manager during
   the first advanced deployment.

*  A fix will be included in IBM BPM V8.5.7 cumulative fix 2016.12
   that prevents the server information from being cached during
   deployment when there are multiple deployment environments
   detected on the same cell.
   
   To determine whether the cumulative fix is available and
   download it if it is, complete the following steps on Fix
   Central:
   
   1. On the Select product tab, select WebSphere as the product
   group, IBM Business Process Manager with your edition from the
   WebSphere options, All as the installed version, and All as the
   platform, and then click Continue.
   2. In the Text field, enter "cumulative fix", and click
   Continue.

*  -----
   For a "Advanced-only Process Server" BPM Development
   environment the user need not run the
   bootstrapProcessServerData script. The user can skip the
   bootstrapProcessServerData script and execute the rest of steps
   suggested in the Admin console > Servers > Deployment
   Environments > [DE_Name ]> Deferred Configuration  panel.

*  A fix for IBM BPM V8.5 is available so that no message is
   shown in Advanced-only cases.

 BPM

*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.6.0 that allows the
   ?BPMConfig -create? command to load the Oracle JDBC driver
   according to the version of the SDK it is running with; database
    connections from BPMConfig (or the Deployment Environment
   wizard in the administrative console) always use the SDK version
    of the running JVM.
   
   JDBC providers are always created with the class path for the
   SDK version of the profile where the deployment environment is
   configured. Profiles are created with the SDK that is configured
   as the new profile default SDK in WebSphere.
   
   Note: IBM BPM does not support mixing SDK versions within the
   deployment environment. The  nodes (profiles) of the deployment
   environment must all have the same SDK version.
   
   On Fix Central (http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral), search
   for JR54039:
   
   1.Select IBM Business Process Manager with your edition from the
   product selector, the installed version to the fix pack level,
   and your platform, and then click Continue.
   2.Select APAR or SPR, enter JR54039, and click Continue.
   When you download fix packages, ensure that you also download
   the readme file for each fix. Review each readme file for
   additional installation instructions and information about the
   fix.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  The UnsupportedClassVersionError occurs because in this setup
   the BPMConfig command runs with SDK version 6 from the default
   profile but tries to load the Oracle JDBC driver ojdbc7.jar
   based on the managesdk command default SDK, which is version 7.
   However, ojdbc7.jar is compiled with Java 7 and, therefore,
   cannot run in a SDK version 6 runtime environment.

*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.5.0 that updates the
   logger implementation in the SCA plug-ins to match the Java 7
   change.

*  With this interim fix the synchronization between different
   threads will be fixed so that access to the exection context by
   multiple threads is possible.
   
   FIX AVAILABILITY:
   iFix for 7.5.1.1 is available on Fix Central, search for APAR
   JR47535 at http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/ [http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/]
   Fix is also targetted for inclusion in next fixpack for BPM
   V7.5.1, BPM 8.0.1, BPM 8.5.0
   
   When obtaining any of the above fixes, be sure to download the
   accompanying readme, for itself, and any prerequisite fixes, and
   review them thorougly.
   
   
    
   
   

TEMPORARY FIX

COMMENTS

*  Workaround to avoid http error 500 is add the following JVM
   arguments to server JVM setting. This allows the server running
   in the en_US locale.

   additional installation instructions and information about the
   fix.

To help resolve the problem, complete the following steps: 

1. Enable tracing. 

2. Change the trace level to capture business process definition (BPD) and service operations with the following trace: *=info:WLE.*=all 

3. Run the application code again. 

4. Locate the exception, and the thread ID, which is the string after the time stamp. See the following example exception:
00001655 wle E CWLLG2015E: An unexpected runtime exception occurred. See exception for more details. 

5. Search the log files prior to this exception for the thread id 00001655

The following code shows the ProcessItem that is being called. The scriptSource is also present, which gives a hint as to the starting block of the server script that will be executed.

1. Enable tracing. 

2. Change the trace level to capture business process definition (BPD) and service operations with the following trace: *=info:WLE.*=all 

3. Run the application code again. 

4. Locate the exception, and the thread ID, which is the string after the time stamp. See the following example exception:
00001655 wle E CWLLG2015E: An unexpected runtime exception occurred. See exception for more details. 

5. Search the log files prior to this exception for the thread id 00001655

The following code shows the ProcessItem that is being called. The scriptSource is also present, which gives a hint as to the starting block of the server script that will be executed.

*  A fix that properly handles the order of context dependencies is
    planned for inclusion in IBM BPM V8.5.7 cumulative fix 2017.03.

PROBLEM SUMMARY

   exception.

*  A fix is available for IBM BPM 8.5.0.1 that deletes the team
   properly.
   
   On Fix Central (http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral), search
   for JR50137:
   
   1. Select IBM Business Process Manager with your edition from
    the product selector, the installed version to the fix pack
    level, and your platform, and then click Continue.
   
   2. Select APAR or SPR, enter JR50137, and click Continue.
   
   When you download fix packages, ensure that you also download
   the readme file for each fix. Review each readme file for
   additional installation instructions and information about the
   fix.
   
   
    
   
   

TEMPORARY FIX

COMMENTS

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  A tw.system.orrg.getAllTeams() call tries to access the already
   deleted team, which results in a java.lang.NullPointerException
   because the team was not deleted properly.

To resolve this issue, complete all of the steps in the Profile upgrade instructions for V7.5.1 Fix Pack 1 (V7.5.1.1) IBM Business Process Manager (BPM) product installations with existing profiles [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27035490] document.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  During the upgrade, the BPMUpdateSystemApp command sets
   tip_snapshot_id to null in the branch table. Later, when it
   tries to retrieve the tip snapshot ID, the command fails and
   logs the NullPointerException.

*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.6 2018.03 that ensures the
   tip_snapshot_id is not set to null, preventing the
   BPMUpdateSystemApp command from failing during the upgrade.
*  n/a

TEMPORARY FIX

COMMENTS

VULNERABILITY DETAILS

CVEID:CVE-2017-1699 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-1699]
DESCRIPTION:An IBM WebSphere MQ or IBM MQ Managed File Transfer agent sets insecure permissions on certain files it creates. A local attacker could exploit this vulnerability to modify or delete data contained in the files with an unknown impact.
CVSS Base Score: 4
CVSS Temporal Score: Seehttps://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/134391 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/134391]for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N) 

AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
WebSphere MQ V8.0.0.0 to V8.0.0.6 

IBM MQ LTS V9.0.0.0 to V9.0.0.1 

IBM MQ CD V9.0.1 to V9.0.3

REMEDIATION/FIXES
WebSphere MQ V8.0.0.0 to V8.0.0.6 

Apply fix pack 8.0.0.7 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22005832] or later. 

 

IBM MQ LTS V9.0.0.0 to V9.0.0.1 

Apply fix pack 9.0.0.2 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24044038] or later 

 

IBM MQ CD V9.0.1 to V9.0.3 

Apply CD release 9.0.4 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24043348]

WORKAROUNDS AND MITIGATIONS
None [S1]

result.answer:
* In Application Manager, verify that the server information on the Taskmaster tab is correct. 
 * In Application Manager, verify that the Service tab points to the correct datacap.xml file and that the file correctly points from there to the application folder.

Server 2: Running only the RuleRunner service

Unable to connect to Datacap application TravelDocs.

Any hints as to what the issue might be ?

Regards

payload.original_query:
Deploying RuleRunner on a separate server


Hello everyone,

I am trying to have a setup as follows:

Server 1: Running Full Datacap Features
Server 2: Running only the RuleRunner service

I managed to deploy Server 1 successfully and all modules are working.

On Server 2, I installed the following:
Datacap Client, Rulerunner, and connectors

I updated the Application Manager on server 2 to point to \\server1\Datacap\datacap.xml

I can successfully open that path from Server 2 using internet explorer.

When I try to open any application such as TravelDocs using Datacap Deskstop from server 2, I receive the following error:

Unable to connect to Datacap application TravelDocs.

Any hints as to what the issue might be ?

Regards

 2. Add the Rulerunner service account to the Datacap folder share properties for full control
    http://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSZRWV_8.1.0/com.ibm.dc.install.doc/dcsrv010.htm [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSZRWV_8.1.0/com.ibm.dc.install.doc/dcsrv010.htm] 
 3. Add Rulerunner service account to the "Distributed COM Users" group policy
    Located in 64-bit at Computer Management > System Tools > Local Users and Groups > Groups
    Located in 32-bit at Server Manager > Configuration > Local Users and Groups > Groups

2)Perform UnInstall of Datacap


3)Restart Server


4)Reinstall IBM Datacap Taskmaster along with connectors desired for
the RR server


5)Install Fix Pack update (FP 4 is the latest version)


6)Reinstate the security keys from the Taskmaster Server, or use the dc_KTF.xml from the backup, onto the RR server so that RR and TM server can communicate security.

2. Path to the general Datacap application folder inside the datacap.xml file

Fourth, ensure that the Windows user has full sharing and security permissions to the application file. Try creating a file or folder where the application file is located.

- Installing Datacap Studio on the machine running Taskmaster Application Manager 

- Installing IBM Datacap Taskmaster Capture 8.x on UAC-enabled PC's using Run as Administrator 

- Installing Microsoft.NET Framework 3.5.1 

 

Second, confirm that your problem is not resolved when right-clicking and running the Taskmaster Application Manager shortcut or executable using the Run As Administrator command. 

 

Third, confirm that all following paths point to the correct locations: 

1. Path to datacap.xml file as indicated in Service tab of Taskmaster Application Manager: 

- x64: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Datacap\Application\Location\'TopPath' 

- x86: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Datacap\Application\Location\'TopPath' 

2. Path to the general Datacap application folder inside the datacap.xml file 

- This is inside the "ref" tag, which generally defaults to a local path or folder

To ensure you can connect successfully, edit the datacap.xml file and move the application that you want to configure in Rulerunner to the top of the list of applications.

Now, when you try to connect, the login attempt will be made to that application instead.
Delete the generated "Rulerunner.xml" file and re-run the Rulerunner installation process that generates the file and this should resolve the issue.

* In Application Manager, verify that the server information on the Taskmaster tab is correct. 
 * In Application Manager, verify that the Service tab points to the correct datacap.xml file and that the file correctly points from there to the application folder. 
 * When starting Rulerunner, verify that Application Manager and Datacap Studio are either not running or specifically in a state that does not lock any files. 
 * If not specified, Rulerunner will attempt to connect through both IPv4 and IPv6. The error will be generated in the log when the unused protocol is tried. For this situation, the error can be ignored. However, the protocol can be set through the Taskmaster tab in Application Manager to eliminate this cause of the error. 
 * Verify that the Rulerunner service is running under an account that has at least read permissions to the application folder. 
 * With multiple threads all attempting to establish connections, some attempts may fail because the server is momentarily busy processing another request. Verify that in the app file, tmservers section, all servers have retry="3".

*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.6.0 that allows the
   ?BPMConfig -create? command to load the Oracle JDBC driver
   according to the version of the SDK it is running with; database
    connections from BPMConfig (or the Deployment Environment
   wizard in the administrative console) always use the SDK version
    of the running JVM.
   
   JDBC providers are always created with the class path for the
   SDK version of the profile where the deployment environment is
   configured. Profiles are created with the SDK that is configured
   as the new profile default SDK in WebSphere.
   
   Note: IBM BPM does not support mixing SDK versions within the
   deployment environment. The  nodes (profiles) of the deployment
   environment must all have the same SDK version.

   product selector, the installed version to the fix pack level,
   and your platform, and then click Continue.
   2.Select APAR or SPR, enter JR54039, and click Continue.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  The UnsupportedClassVersionError occurs because in this setup
   the BPMConfig command runs with SDK version 6 from the default
   profile but tries to load the Oracle JDBC driver ojdbc7.jar
   based on the managesdk command default SDK, which is version 7.

*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.6.0 that allows the
   ?BPMConfig -create? command to load the Oracle JDBC driver
   according to the version of the SDK it is running with; database
    connections from BPMConfig (or the Deployment Environment
   wizard in the administrative console) always use the SDK version
    of the running JVM.
   
   JDBC providers are always created with the class path for the
   SDK version of the profile where the deployment environment is
   configured. Profiles are created with the SDK that is configured
   as the new profile default SDK in WebSphere.
   
   Note: IBM BPM does not support mixing SDK versions within the
   deployment environment. The  nodes (profiles) of the deployment
   environment must all have the same SDK version.
   
   On Fix Central (http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral), search
   for JR54039:
   
   1.Select IBM Business Process Manager with your edition from the
   product selector, the installed version to the fix pack level,
   and your platform, and then click Continue.
   2.Select APAR or SPR, enter JR54039, and click Continue.
   When you download fix packages, ensure that you also download
   the readme file for each fix. Review each readme file for
   additional installation instructions and information about the
   fix.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  The UnsupportedClassVersionError occurs because in this setup
   the BPMConfig command runs with SDK version 6 from the default
   profile but tries to load the Oracle JDBC driver ojdbc7.jar
   based on the managesdk command default SDK, which is version 7.
   However, ojdbc7.jar is compiled with Java 7 and, therefore,
   cannot run in a SDK version 6 runtime environment.

*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.5.0 that updates the
   logger implementation in the SCA plug-ins to match the Java 7
   change.

*  With this interim fix the synchronization between different
   threads will be fixed so that access to the exection context by
   multiple threads is possible.

   V7.5.1, BPM 8.0.1, BPM 8.5.0
   
   When obtaining any of the above fixes, be sure to download the
   accompanying readme, for itself, and any prerequisite fixes, and
   review them thorougly.

evidence.excerpt:
*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.6.0 that allows the
   ?BPMConfig -create? command to load the Oracle JDBC driver
   according to the version of the SDK it is running with; database
    connections from BPMConfig (or the Deployment Environment
   wizard in the administrative console) always use the SDK version
    of the running JVM.
   
   JDBC providers are always created with the class path for the
   SDK version of the profile where the deployment environment is
   configured. Profiles are created with the SDK that is configured
   as the new profile default SDK in WebSphere.
   
   Note: IBM BPM does not support mixing SDK versions within the
   deployment environment. The  nodes (profiles) of the deployment
   environment must all have the same SDK version.
   
   On Fix Central (http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral), search
   for JR54039:
   
   1.Select IBM Business Process Manager with your edition from the
   product selector, the installed version to the fix pack level,
   and your platform, and then click Continue.
   2.Select APAR or SPR, enter JR54039, and click Continue.
   When you download fix packages, ensure that you also download
   the readme file for each fix. Review each readme file for
   additional installation instructions and information about the
   fix.

*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.6.0 that allows the
   ?BPMConfig -create? command to load the Oracle JDBC driver
   according to the version of the SDK it is running with; database
    connections from BPMConfig (or the Deployment Environment
   wizard in the administrative console) always use the SDK version
    of the running JVM.
   
   JDBC providers are always created with the class path for the
   SDK version of the profile where the deployment environment is
   configured. Profiles are created with the SDK that is configured
   as the new profile default SDK in WebSphere.
   
   Note: IBM BPM does not support mixing SDK versions within the
   deployment environment. The  nodes (profiles) of the deployment
   environment must all have the same SDK version.
   
   On Fix Central (http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral), search
   for JR54039:
   
   1.Select IBM Business Process Manager with your edition from the
   product selector, the installed version to the fix pack level,
   and your platform, and then click Continue.
   2.Select APAR or SPR, enter JR54039, and click Continue.
   When you download fix packages, ensure that you also download
   the readme file for each fix. Review each readme file for
   additional installation instructions and information about the
   fix.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  The UnsupportedClassVersionError occurs because in this setup
   the BPMConfig command runs with SDK version 6 from the default
   profile but tries to load the Oracle JDBC driver ojdbc7.jar
   based on the managesdk command default SDK, which is version 7.
   However, ojdbc7.jar is compiled with Java 7 and, therefore,
   cannot run in a SDK version 6 runtime environment.

*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.5.0 that updates the
   logger implementation in the SCA plug-ins to match the Java 7
   change.

*  With this interim fix the synchronization between different
   threads will be fixed so that access to the exection context by
   multiple threads is possible.

   iFix for 7.5.1.1 is available on Fix Central, search for APAR
   JR47535 at http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/ [http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/]
   Fix is also targetted for inclusion in next fixpack for BPM
   V7.5.1, BPM 8.0.1, BPM 8.5.0
   
   When obtaining any of the above fixes, be sure to download the
   accompanying readme, for itself, and any prerequisite fixes, and
   review them thorougly.
